programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piripenguins fall under the spell of a magical Merguin, a mermaid-penguin, who has the ability to change their personality. But all is not as it seems.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun blowing and popping bubbles. In the Cloud Kitchen, all the bubbles give Patch an idea for a tasty treat - blast off melon rockets!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: It's a windy day, and Bing wants to fly his Hoppity Voosh kite with Flop. And he wants to do it all by himself. Even when Pando arrives and wants to help, Bing insists on doing it his way. When the kite gets caught up in the park bench, Bing realises that there are some times when another pair of hands come in handy.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘donkey’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We meet all sorts of donkeys – a brown donkey, a grey donkey, an eating-lots-of-hay donkey. There’s a nosy donkey and a long-eared donkey, a hee-hawing donkey and even a see-sawing donkey!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu is disappointed to see she's not the only Tara at Costume Day.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou meet a shy little creature called Small. It turns out she’s a fan, and she’s even written a song about them!

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets turn Alex's chessboard into a dance floor and bust out their top disco moves.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a musician playing a drum kit. He starts out playing softly, and gets louder until the Twirlywoos have to cover their ears. When he leaves, the Twirlywoos come out and start to investigate the drums. Chickedy and Chick jump on the snare drums, Great BigHoo steps on the bass pedal, and Toodloo dances on the cymbals. As they get carried away, they play louder and louder, until they're making an almighty racket! The Hooter calls them home just as the musician returns, and he's surprised to find his cymbals still swinging. Peekaboo has found a shell to use as a trumpet, but can only get a tiny squeak out of it. When the Twirlywoos return, Peekaboo leaves the shell and rushes back to the hole in the wall. Chickedy and Chick try blowing into the shell, but they can only make a small noise. Toodloo tries and manages to make it a bit louder. Then Great BigHoo has a go and makes a loud trumpeting sound. The Hooter responds with a loud honk of its own, and the two compete to see who can make the loudest noise.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie visits Effie to help her get Teddy ready for bed. Mr Tumble is feeling sleepy too, and he tries to take a nap. There's a bedtime story in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words teddy bear, pyjamas and good night.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies bounce on the Tubby Bouncy. Po bounces as high as a cloud, then Laa-Laa bounces higher, Dipsy bounces even higher and Tinky Winky bounces highest of all.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Noah, Baani, Millana, Amber, Amelia, Jace, Hunter and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are cups which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate cups inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song Polly Put the Kettle On features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. And, the Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create tree rubbings to make unique art, learning British Sign Language signs for baby, wind and treetop, then sing and sign the gentle lullaby Hush-a-Bye Baby.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Henna artist Pavan introduces the Fact Pack to her henna plant. They learn how henna leaves are turned into a natural dye, how mehndi patterns are created, and why henna is used for celebrations around the world.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It's picnic day! Rebecca and Murphi create a 'soup-er' fly in a bowl of soup. On the Recycling Express, an old storage tub becomes a totally terrific tub drum kit.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes help a beached Watermelonsuchus into the water during a heatwave.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad send her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to attend the cinema together for the first time with Duggee, who teaches them that you should adhere to three rules in order for everyone to enjoy the experience: stay quiet, don’t fidget or kick the chair in front and go to the toilet before the film starts. The Squirrels quickly learn that the short films they are enjoying are only trailers before the film starts. Hopefully, the Squirrels can maintain their focus in order to watch the film all the way through to the end credits and earn their cinema badges.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk through the town to the place they can do their recycling. On the way they climb a lookout tower, listen to the wind blowing in the trees, play musical statues and even beep like reversing buses!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava set up a beauty salon and make their very own face mask mixture. Dad pops along for a beauty treatment, but will his visit leave him feeling relaxed? Later, the family heads to the park for a game of hide-and-seek, and a cheeky squirrel decides to join in the fun.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Hannah's family is from South Korea, and she will be making a Korean salmon marinade, which is a popular recipe used there. She starts by adding garlic puree, Korean chilli paste, soy sauce, honey, toasted sesame oil and her special ingredient, sesame seeds, into a jug and mixing them all up. Next, Hannah puts pieces of her salmon onto individual baking sheets and spoons the marinade on. She garnishes them with freshly chopped spring onions, and then her salmon is ready to be cooked in the oven. Hannah wears a colourful Korean outfit and treats her friends to some local Korean kimchi, but will her pals be able to guess her special ingredient?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie visits beehives on the roof of a building in the city. She finds out how honey bees make honey in the hive. Maddie puts on a special beekeeping suit before the beekeeper opens the hive to see the busy bees working away. She uses her special slo-motion camera to see the bees fanning the hive with their wings to make the liquid honey evaporate and turn thick and sticky. We also see them carrying the pollen from the flowers in tiny ‘pollen baskets’ on their legs. Next, Maddie visits a pottery to find out how mugs are made from clay. We see the big lumps of clay being shaped into a mug shape by a fast spinning machine. Then Maddie shows us how the brightly coloured stripy glaze is painted on by hand.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Therapy dog Toffee and his owner Helen are visiting a lady called Anita, who lives on her own, to keep her company and to listen to all her amazing stories.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the jungle enclosure to meet some tuataras. These incredible lizards have been around since the time of the dinosaurs. They are one of the slowest growing reptiles in the world and can live to be 100 years old. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Eti, a burrowing owl. These tiny owls live in the deserts and grasslands of North and South America, where there are very few trees. So, unlike other owls, they live underground in burrows. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Mama organises a fun treasure hunt for Baba.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee enjoys the peace and quiet in the garden when she wakes up early. But she soon discovers that while it might be quiet, the garden is never silent.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Triggs's chewy ball gets lost, Maddie and Triggs discover a whole world run by the Dust Bunnies - the tiny creatures who keep all the stuff that ends up under the couch! Can Maddie and Triggs convince them that they are caring and responsible enough to get their ball back?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you’ll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten turns up to tell the Numberblocks what it's like to be a perfect ten. Learn all about the number 10 with Numberblock Ten.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. P, A, R and Y plan a surprise for T - but first they must get out of a trap!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Ellis to explore emotions. They relax in a sensory room, stroke a therapy dog and join George to play with modelling dough. Mr Tumble is trying to chill out but keeps getting interrupted. There are some calming crafts in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words bubbles, calm and dough.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies have their favourite things and the Noo-noo wants to join in. When the Tubby Phone rings, the Teletubbies and the Noo-noo do the Tubby Phone dance together.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how the wind plays an important role in the environment. They find out that the wind makes waves on the sea and that it can help boats and birds to travel more quickly. On the way, they spot a washing line with clothes drying in the wind and blow some bubbles to show how the wind helps seeds to grow in new places.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Theo turns an errand to fetch a new ball into an imaginative quest to find a lion at the Den. Meanwhile, Barry’s practising being a lion mascot for the day - will the two meet?

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Grace shows off three amazing machines that all help us build things! She hammers in concrete foundations with a pile driving rig, and then she shows off an unusual pedestal crane before driving an electric mini dumpster!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger encounters an injured Mamma Pea-Rex, who quickly befriends the baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When Paani goes missing in the desert, Dashi calls for back-up before he runs out of water

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Felix and Nutkin quarrel, leaving the Squirrel Camp in chaos, it's down to Peter to help them make up before disaster strikes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can’t stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee’s dream!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Daphne gets a Chewy-Fruity sweet stuck in her hair. Luckily, Vida is on hand to help.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Chilli says he’s a great skateboarder, but when Supertato needs his help to catch Evil Pea, Chilli can’t skateboard at all! Carrot, Chilli and Supertato create a ‘chilli rocket’ to defeat Evil Pea.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy smashes a hole in the grain store with his boomerang. The farmer thinks his cow is to blame and decides to sell it. The ducklings can't believe Weasy would allow the cow to take the blame - they need to sort this out!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: A camping trip with Preston goes very wrong when he won’t let them use Mojo’s tops. But camping Preston’s way soon starts a fire. It’s Mojo and Bo to the rescue!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and won’t let Mum have a smoochy kiss!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo and Floppy have an intergalactic adventure in Bingo’s dream, while the rest of her sleep-deprived family try to navigate Bingo’s nonstop night-time bed-hopping.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: When Gadabout and Pearl lose the cure for Madam Dragon’s missing flame, Zog helps them work together to assist his former teacher.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When Jen is carried away by a weather balloon, Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to rescue her. Along the way, they meet the mighty Alamosaurus, a gigantic dinosaur that's as long as two double-decker buses! It comes to their aid when they get trapped on an island by an ancient crocodilian, called Deinosuchus, lurking in the surrounding waters.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Evie and Waffle arrive home from school with Gramps for a playdate with Ruby and her dog, Jelly. Just as they’re all about to go inside the house, a delivery van arrives with shopping for Mrs Hobbs, next door.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi makes gingerbread people for the bakery but thinks they look messy next to Jake’s neat ones. She wishes them to be perfect - and suddenly they spring to life! The cheeky gingerbreads dash through the café, splattering icing and riding on Deborah’s back as they try to reach Gingerbread Land. With Jake’s help, Rafi traps them under a cake dome. Dash reminds her that their messy look is what makes them special.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: At the community jam, everyone makes music together. Gran Gran gives JoJo a shaker to join in with the band, but with Charlene stuck in traffic, JoJo might need to sing too!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Tortoise is on a mission straight through Sarah and Duck's house! The pair try to work out what he's crawling towards.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Baby Soup Dragon gets his tail stuck in the doors leading to the living cave. Annoyed, he wonders why he has a tail at all. His mother tells him it’s for balance, but as this seems a boring idea, Baby Soup Dragon determines that he will explore other possible uses. He tries using his tail as a cotton ball bat, as a steering aid, and even for fanning away glowbuzzers like a skymoo. But in the end he finds, in an exciting discovery, that balancing is not such a boring thing after all.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa play I spy with my little eye with Gramma Leeba. At Play Time, they play with a finger kite which makes a flappy sound. When the kite is caught in the wind, it flies off. MeMo and BaBa play I hear with my little ear to track the flappy finger kite down, all the way to Yummy Land. The Yummies have cooked a pie, and MeMo and BaBa play I spy with my little nose to work out the flavour.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures. Igglepiggle is skipping through the garden. Suddenly he lets out a very big sneeze. Soon Upsy Daisy and the Tombliboos are sneezing too. Makka Pakka is tidying his stones when he lets out such a big sneeze that it makes the Pinky Ponk bump into a tree.

programme.desc: Idris Elba reads a Bedtime Story about Percy the Park Keeper helping a hedgehog have fun.

programme.title: Froglets

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a musician playing a drum kit. He starts out playing softly, and gets louder until the Twirlywoos have to cover their ears. When he leaves, the Twirlywoos come out and start to investigate the drums. Chickedy and Chick jump on the snare drums, Great BigHoo steps on the bass pedal, and Toodloo dances on the cymbals. As they get carried away, they play louder and louder, until they're making an almighty racket! The Hooter calls them home just as the musician returns, and he's surprised to find his cymbals still swinging. Peekaboo has found a shell to use as a trumpet, but can only get a tiny squeak out of it. When the Twirlywoos return, Peekaboo leaves the shell and rushes back to the hole in the wall. Chickedy and Chick try blowing into the shell, but they can only make a small noise. Toodloo tries and manages to make it a bit louder. Then Great BigHoo has a go and makes a loud trumpeting sound. The Hooter responds with a loud honk of its own, and the two compete to see who can make the loudest noise.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie visits Effie to help her get Teddy ready for bed. Mr Tumble is feeling sleepy too, and he tries to take a nap. There's a bedtime story in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words teddy bear, pyjamas and good night.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies bounce on the Tubby Bouncy. Po bounces as high as a cloud, then Laa-Laa bounces higher, Dipsy bounces even higher and Tinky Winky bounces highest of all.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Noah, Baani, Millana, Amber, Amelia, Jace, Hunter and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are cups which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate cups inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song Polly Put the Kettle On features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. And, the Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create tree rubbings to make unique art, learning British Sign Language signs for baby, wind and treetop, then sing and sign the gentle lullaby Hush-a-Bye Baby.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Henna artist Pavan introduces the Fact Pack to her henna plant. They learn how henna leaves are turned into a natural dye, how mehndi patterns are created, and why henna is used for celebrations around the world.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It's picnic day! Rebecca and Murphi create a 'soup-er' fly in a bowl of soup. On the Recycling Express, an old storage tub becomes a totally terrific tub drum kit.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes help a beached Watermelonsuchus into the water during a heatwave.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad send her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to attend the cinema together for the first time with Duggee, who teaches them that you should adhere to three rules in order for everyone to enjoy the experience: stay quiet, don’t fidget or kick the chair in front and go to the toilet before the film starts. The Squirrels quickly learn that the short films they are enjoying are only trailers before the film starts. Hopefully, the Squirrels can maintain their focus in order to watch the film all the way through to the end credits and earn their cinema badges.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk through the town to the place they can do their recycling. On the way they climb a lookout tower, listen to the wind blowing in the trees, play musical statues and even beep like reversing buses!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava set up a beauty salon and make their very own face mask mixture. Dad pops along for a beauty treatment, but will his visit leave him feeling relaxed? Later, the family heads to the park for a game of hide-and-seek, and a cheeky squirrel decides to join in the fun.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Hannah's family is from South Korea, and she will be making a Korean salmon marinade, which is a popular recipe used there. She starts by adding garlic puree, Korean chilli paste, soy sauce, honey, toasted sesame oil and her special ingredient, sesame seeds, into a jug and mixing them all up. Next, Hannah puts pieces of her salmon onto individual baking sheets and spoons the marinade on. She garnishes them with freshly chopped spring onions, and then her salmon is ready to be cooked in the oven. Hannah wears a colourful Korean outfit and treats her friends to some local Korean kimchi, but will her pals be able to guess her special ingredient?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie visits beehives on the roof of a building in the city. She finds out how honey bees make honey in the hive. Maddie puts on a special beekeeping suit before the beekeeper opens the hive to see the busy bees working away. She uses her special slo-motion camera to see the bees fanning the hive with their wings to make the liquid honey evaporate and turn thick and sticky. We also see them carrying the pollen from the flowers in tiny ‘pollen baskets’ on their legs. Next, Maddie visits a pottery to find out how mugs are made from clay. We see the big lumps of clay being shaped into a mug shape by a fast spinning machine. Then Maddie shows us how the brightly coloured stripy glaze is painted on by hand.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Therapy dog Toffee and his owner Helen are visiting a lady called Anita, who lives on her own, to keep her company and to listen to all her amazing stories.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the jungle enclosure to meet some tuataras. These incredible lizards have been around since the time of the dinosaurs. They are one of the slowest growing reptiles in the world and can live to be 100 years old. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Eti, a burrowing owl. These tiny owls live in the deserts and grasslands of North and South America, where there are very few trees. So, unlike other owls, they live underground in burrows. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee enjoys the peace and quiet in the garden when she wakes up early. But she soon discovers that while it might be quiet, the garden is never silent.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Triggs's chewy ball gets lost, Maddie and Triggs discover a whole world run by the Dust Bunnies - the tiny creatures who keep all the stuff that ends up under the couch! Can Maddie and Triggs convince them that they are caring and responsible enough to get their ball back?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you’ll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten turns up to tell the Numberblocks what it's like to be a perfect ten. Learn all about the number 10 with Numberblock Ten.

programme.title: Alphablocks

They find out that the wind makes waves on the sea and that it can help boats and birds to travel more quickly. On the way, they spot a washing line with clothes drying in the wind and blow some bubbles to show how the wind helps seeds to grow in new places.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: After an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the big move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends - will Becky and Jamie's grand plans for Sofia's birthday be enough to take her mind off friends back home? With Jamie's punishing training schedule taking its toll, he doesn't get as much time with the family as he'd like, leaving Becky to help them settle in and do her best to source home comforts for the kids - but she can't find baked beans or orange squash anywhere. Still, Jamie makes time for some magic family moments, and the family begin to find their feet, learning the language, experiencing the culture and Jamie makes his much-awaited debut on the pitch with explosive results.

programme.desc: After an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the big move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends - will Becky and Jamie's grand plans for Sofia's birthday be enough to take her mind off friends back home? With Jamie's punishing training schedule taking its toll, he doesn't get as much time with the family as he'd like, leaving Becky to help them settle in and do her best to source home comforts for the kids - but she can't find baked beans or orange squash anywhere. Still, Jamie makes time for some magic family moments, and the family begin to find their feet, learning the language, experiencing the culture and Jamie makes his much-awaited debut on the pitch with explosive results.
